decisions.summary: Profile Files and desktop/mobile-web Profile are complete; the native Profile renderer and component operations are implemented while iOS/Android device acceptance remains outstanding. Security renderers are present, while their ledger tasks remain ready until acceptance evidence satisfies their criteria.
Use Metro's .native.ts resolution for Expo SecureStore so native builds use secure storage without importing React Native into root Vite tests.
User approved provider-backed sign-out of all other sessions; do not implement individual session inventory or per-session revocation.

User approved updating canonical PlatformUser.fullName and avatarUrl through Auth and reusing private user-owned Files for avatars; the shared adapter, migration and isolated local RLS tests are complete.
User selected TOTP authenticator apps as the initial MFA method; SMS MFA is excluded.
User approved retaining pending preference changes against the original account and syncing only after that same account signs in again.
User approved not importing existing local notification values; server/default preferences are authoritative.
User approved merging concurrent changes to different fields and surfacing a conflict when the same field changed.
User approved adapting the Expo app to light, dark and system appearance while retaining device-local appearance ownership.

User decided Billing is not ready for use: keep its menu entry visible but disabled across desktop, sidebar, command palette and mobile, remove its routable page, and do not redirect to another destination until Billing provider/commercial readiness is approved.

actions: Implemented the shared Account navigation contract with stable IDs, protected canonical paths and replace-style legacy redirects.
Hardened mobile Auth storage, provider operation results and server-authoritative membership/permission resolution.

Implemented canonical authenticated-user profile updates on desktop and mobile with opaque Files references, version conflict checks, provider errors and focused contract tests; Files upload and URL resolution remain out of scope.
Implemented private avatar Files adapters and migration; all 16 database RLS tests passed against an isolated local Supabase stack without modifying the existing local database.
Added regression tests for identity changes and membership lookup failures so stale tenant context is not retained.
Added provider-backed sign-out-other-sessions semantics to shared AuthPort and desktop/mobile adapters; current session remains active.
Added authenticated-subject security status, email-change, password and TOTP contracts/adapters; provider step-up failures remain explicit.
Recorded user-approved session scope and TOTP-only MFA; operation parity remains incomplete.
Implemented the desktop Security renderer, protected canonical route, legacy redirect and Topbar destination.
Implemented the Expo Security screen and account-sheet route for mobile web/iOS/Android using existing mobile primitives.
Added seven mobile Security component tests using Vitest-only React Native shims; production Metro resolution is unchanged.

Checked desktop route/refresh/legacy redirect and Expo Web navigation/refresh/legacy redirect/back/invalid-email behavior without submitting successful account mutations; native device runtime remains unavailable.
Implemented a shared private-user Files port and Supabase adapter for desktop and Expo, including upload validation, ownership, short-lived signed previews, soft deletion and physical orphan cleanup.
Added a shared profile-avatar orchestrator that updates only canonical Auth profile fields, compensates failed profile writes and reports cleanup failures.

Added migration and database RLS regression coverage for personal ownership and organization Files continuity; all 16 pgTAP tests passed on an isolated local Supabase stack without modifying the existing local database.
Implemented the desktop Profile renderer with authenticated reads, display-name updates, private avatar upload/preview/removal, conflict reload, canonical route and legacy replace redirect.

Implemented the Expo Profile screen and canonical account navigation from the account sheet and More surface; name, avatar selection/upload/signed preview/removal use shared Auth/Profile/Private Files adapters.
Added seven native Profile operation/state tests and isolated Expo Image Picker behind a mobile adapter; camera and microphone permissions remain disabled.
Updated Topbar, command menu and app navigation to the canonical Profile destination; added six-locale copy and route smoke coverage.
Adapted Profile controls for mobile web with 44px minimum touch targets, visible keyboard focus, RTL logical positioning, and matching confirmation actions.
Implemented shared versioned/idempotent Preferences RPC sync, per-user durable queue recovery for web and mobile, field-path merge/conflict handling, owner-only SQL RLS and pgTAP coverage.

Implemented the desktop Preferences renderer, canonical and legacy routes, account navigation, six-locale copy and honest sync/conflict/error feedback while preserving organization settings at /app/settings.

Disabled the Billing destination across the desktop account menu, sidebar, command palette and mobile account sheet, removed its mock page route, and added regressions proving disabled entries do not navigate and direct billing paths do not redirect.
Corrected Preferences language initialization so the current app locale seeds only an uninitialized server preference; explicit saved language remains authoritative.

Added desktop/shared-adapter regression tests and a database migration for language initialization; applied the migration to the linked Dev project and verified that the explicit Spanish preference survives an authenticated route reload.

Updated the authenticated global Topbar language selector to persist through the shared Preferences adapter before changing app i18n, preventing Account Settings from restoring a stale server language.

requirements.evidence: Shared destination semantics and focused contract test are recorded in 07-build-evidence.md.
Provider/storage/role behavior and focused tests are recorded in 07-build-evidence.md.

Canonical authenticated-user profile update contract, web/mobile adapter behavior, private avatar reference validation, conflict handling and focused tests are recorded in 07-build-evidence.md; Files upload and signed URL resolution are tracked by ACCOUNT-PROFILE-FILES.

Shared Files/Auth avatar adapters, validation, signed previews, orphan compensation and deletion tests pass; all 16 self-only RLS and organization continuity tests passed on an isolated local Supabase stack. Desktop and mobile-web renderers now consume these adapters; native Profile remains outstanding.

Desktop Profile uses Auth and private Files ports for read/name/avatar operations, includes conflict/error/loading/unauthenticated states, opens at the protected canonical route, and replaces the legacy route. Ten operation/state tests and three route/history tests pass; the browser confirmed authentication gating.

Responsive mobile-web Profile reuses shared Auth/Files operations; 44px minimum controls, RTL logical positioning, keyboard-visible focus, pending/error states and route history are covered by 10 component and 3 routing tests. No authenticated browser mutation or native parity is claimed.

Native Expo Profile route and shared Auth/Files operations are implemented; 7 focused component/state tests pass, and Web/iOS/Android bundles export. OS-level navigation, safe area, keyboard, touch and image-picker permission behavior remain unverified, so the ledger task remains in_progress.

Provider-backed subject-scoped security status, email-change requests, password changes, TOTP lifecycle, explicit reauthentication errors and other-session sign-out pass focused desktop/mobile tests and validators.
Desktop and mobile use provider-scoped signOut({ scope: 'others' }), preserve the active session, and surface provider failures without fabricated device inventory.

Shared web/mobile adapter and identity-bound durable queue pass 7 focused adapter tests and 8 contract tests; web/mobile typechecks and boundary/contract validators pass. The migration was applied to a fresh isolated local Supabase project and all 12 pgTAP tests passed for subject ownership, direct-write isolation, idempotency, disjoint-field merge, same-field conflicts and validation. After explicit user approval, the preferences migration and two other pending migrations were applied to the authorized Dev project only; remote migration history and function registration were verified. No staging or production database was modified.

Desktop personal Preferences route, legacy replacement, navigation, remote language/timezone/notification mutations, local-only appearance and sync/error/conflict states pass 12 focused component tests and 3 route tests. A further 21-test focused run covers authenticated global Topbar language persistence before changing app i18n; root typecheck and six-locale validation pass. Authenticated browser confirms Español survives route reload; the global selector itself was not live-clicked because it is hidden at the browser canvas viewport. The updated 18-assertion pgTAP suite remains unrun because Docker is unavailable.

Expo Preferences screen and account/More destinations implement the shared operations; 13 focused route/preferences/theme/i18n tests, the 115-test Account suite, root/mobile typechecks, Expo Doctor 21/21 and Web/iOS/Android bundle export pass. iOS/Android runtime acceptance for restart recovery, identity binding, safe area, system back, touch and locale changes remains unverified because simctl and adb are unavailable; task remains in_progress.

Security renderers and desktop/mobile operation tests are present; Expo Web route journeys were checked without provider mutations. Structured E4 evidence and iOS/Android device journeys are outstanding; Profile native, native Preferences device acceptance and Billing remain incomplete. No multiplatform operation parity is claimed.

detected_failure.summary: Initial isolated pgTAP execution found ambiguous PL/pgSQL references to mutation_id and changed_fields. The migration variables were disambiguated; the corrected migration and all 12 pgTAP tests passed.

likely_failure_origin.summary: Function parameters/locals shared names with SQL columns; the runtime ambiguity was revealed by the database tests and corrected before task completion.

next_handoff: The Preferences locale migration is applied to linked Dev and explicit Spanish remains selected after an authenticated route reload. Run the updated 18-assertion pgTAP suite against an isolated local database when Docker is available; do not run it against the shared Dev database. Billing remains explicitly disabled and has no route until provider/commercial/server readiness is approved; its implementation tasks remain blocked. ACCOUNT-PREFS-NATIVE renderer and component coverage are implemented, but keep the task in_progress until iOS and Android device journeys prove identity-bound restart recovery, safe area, system back, touch and locale changes. This host has neither simctl nor adb. Preserve separate native Profile/Security device evidence; do not claim Account operation parity.
